description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) used for filtering employee education search parameters within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class, adds an employee number property, and sets a default sort field.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering employee education search results, including employee number and sort field configurations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object with default sort field 'e.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion.
